text: [HIRING] Video Editors – True Crime YouTube. We're building a team for a YouTube channel focused on long-form, single-case true crime documentaries (40+ minutes). Our content will take inspiration from channels such as Dr Insanity, Explore With Us, EWU Crime Storytime, Sinister Sins, Deadly Sins, and Red File. Must have worked on long-form true crime videos (40+ minutes). Videos must cover one case per video, not compilations. Must have worked on videos that reached 5 MILLION+ views. Rate: $500 - $900 (Depends on Experience).

[Hiring] Senior Video Editor (Direct Response Ads) | $4,000/month + commission. A full-time senior editor for Meta and TikTok ads: VSLs, UGC, hook stacks, AI UGC and animated ads. We'll train you to write your own scripts and briefs. You have 3+ years editing paid social ads, ideally e-commerce, supplements or info products; you can show ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok; you've made AI UGC or AI avatar ads; your English is strong.

Hiring a Short-Form/Reels Video Editor specializing in Magic the Gathering. I'm one of the two people behind a moderately successful MTG Channel... We'd be looking for someone to hire for $30 USD per video with additional profit sharing on each video pending performance. We'd ideally find someone who's editing style matches ours or someone who can learn our style. We're pretty relaxed in regards to delivery time.

WE'RE HIRING VIDEO EDITORS. $15 per accepted edit + $20 daily bonus. Create engaging 22–30 second montages using raw footage across Sports & Action, Travel & Adventure, Lifestyle & Cinematic Content. Strong editing fundamentals: advanced masking and motion tracking, professional colour grading, speed ramps and seamless transitions, precise beat synchronisation, sound effects and music integration. We're looking for actual editing expertise, not just preset-based edits.

[Hiring] Short-Form Video Editor (YouTube Shorts). Edit 3 high-quality YouTube Shorts per day (typically 60–80 seconds each). Transform provided scripts and voiceovers into engaging, highly polished videos. Find and select the best in-game footage from our prerecorded footage library. Use compelling pacing, sound design, music, and visual storytelling to maximize viewer retention... We're looking for someone who understands what makes a Short go viral — not just someone who knows how to edit... We're not looking for flashy effects for the sake of flashy effects. We're looking for an editor who knows how to make every second count.

VIDEO EDITOR WANTED – LONG-TERM. Short-form (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) & YouTube edits. Fast pacing, dynamic subtitles, and engaging visual cuts. Raw footage and clear briefs provided for every video. Must send a portfolio with real human-edited work (No AI-generated videos). Strict adherence to deadlines. $15–$30+ per video.

[Hiring] $600 / Month Video Editor. 8x Long Form Videos Per Month (10-15 minutes), 30x Short form videos per month (10x edits, 10x simple talking corner head with images, 10x board videos). Checking analytics on the long form videos, understanding where retention was high/low and why... A long-form has to hold someone for the full runtime: tight pacing, clean structure, visuals that carry the explanation, not a wasted second... You have to understand our subject inside out... Everything we put out has to be accurate and credible while still holding attention.

Video editor for construction company short-form content (Reels/TikTok/X), $25–40 per video. We film a lot on the job: before-and-afters, carpentry close-ups, and quick trade tips that explain the "why" behind a technique. Short vertical videos (15–60 sec) cut from our raw job footage. Strong hooks in the first 2 seconds, clean captions, simple branding (logo and colors provided). Ready-to-post versions for Instagram Reels, TikTok and X. Starting with about 3–5 videos a week.

[Hiring] Senior Video Editor for Fashion Brand — Social Media, YouTube, Podcasts & Docu-Series. You will edit Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, long-form YouTube videos, podcasts, docu-series, fashion shoots and campaign footage... Ability to create premium, sophisticated content appropriate for a fashion/luxury brand. Strong understanding of branding and maintaining a consistent visual identity. Ability to work independently and recommend creative improvements rather than simply following editing instructions.

[Hiring] Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer (AI Video Experience). Turning creative briefs and storyboards into polished video content... Generating and refining AI video assets using Seedance, Kling, and other tools. Compositing AI-generated footage with live-action or stock footage, ensuring visual consistency... Creating short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid social ads.

[Hiring] Editor for a ~15 min storytime video — $450 flat + paid test edit. It's a personal storytime explaining why I've been gone ~2 months... heavy material told in my normal voice. There are jokes all the way through, but there are also a few moments where the correct edit is nothing at all. I need someone who can tell the difference. Raw: 90–120 min of talking head. Target final: ~15 minutes, punchy. Cut in 4 short scripted comedy bits. Memes, SFX, b-roll across the drier stretches. One motion-graphics data timeline. One small VFX shot. Subtitles. I'll be providing a full beat-by-beat brief... Two revision rounds included.

[HIRING] Video Editor. I'm looking for a video editor who can replicate the style shown in the reference videos. I'm planning to start a finance YouTube channel... I don't want the videos to be over-edited with flashy effects or something happening every 3 seconds. I'm looking for a smooth, clean edit, tailored to viewers in the 25–30 age range. I'm especially interested in strong sound design and background music that fits the overall tone. The videos will be around 10–12 minutes long. I'll provide the raw footage of myself speaking... At the moment, the maximum I can afford is $15/hour.

Looking for a Video Editor – Men's Fashion Content. I'm looking for a skilled video editor who can help edit content for social media. Ideally, you should be comfortable with video editing, color grading, pacing, transitions, and creating content that looks clean, polished, and engaging. Bonus points if you have previous experience editing content in the men's fashion / menswear niche. Pay is 5-10 usd depending on experience and skill.
